turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Happy to help! I'll pass your booking to a colleague. First, please tell me: your tattoo idea, the size, the placement on your body, and when you are available. I can't give a price or a date, the team will do that.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you! I passed your details to a colleague: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, outside of the left forearm, weekday evenings. A colleague will take over and talk to you about the price and the date.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a tattoo. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date was given to the customer.
